title: Local-model dedupe test does not cover provider/model pairs across providers
reasoning: The test name and assertion target deduplication of provider/model pairs, but the duplicate fixture always returns provider='ollama'. The test registers the fixture under both 'ollama' and 'lmstudio', yet the payloads themselves are identical ollama/dup-model entries, so it only proves exact duplicate payload removal. It would not catch a regression that incorrectly deduplicates by model id alone and drops a legitimate lmstudio/dup-model entry.
recommendation: Change the fixture or add a second fixture that returns the factory provider name so the suite verifies that identical ids from different providers are retained while exact provider/id duplicates are collapsed.
whyTestsDoNotAlreadyCoverThis: The current assertions expect a single ollama entry and never include a valid lmstudio/dup-model payload to prove cross-provider duplicates survive.
suggestedRegressionTest: Add a test where ollama and lmstudio each return id='dup-model' with their own provider value, and assert both provider/id pairs are present.
minimumFixScope: Update tests/backend/test_model_service.py fixture coverage for local model deduplication.
